topic: Mobile phone vendor market share by brand, worldwide (StatCounter, monthly)

interpretations.label: Market share
interpretations.description: Share of worldwide mobile device usage attributed to each vendor
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Vendor market share in percent of total mobile traffic
caveats: StatCounter measures browser/page-view traffic, not unit sales

knownRisks: Vendor naming changes over time (e.g. RIM/BlackBerry)
Monthly granularity: short-term noise in shares
